GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (3L from lead). Stayed Mid Field Two Wide midrace & improved to track leaders Two Wide @ 600m. Pushed along Four Wide @ 500m & pressured Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Weakend Five Wide in straight. # Poor from turn

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 1.75 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up 3 Wide Outside Lead at 1800m, in Two Wide by the 1600m, Moved Up to Two Wide joint Lead at 500m, led jointly turning, Headed Straightening Up and Lost Ground in straight. # worked a bit early

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and shifted in, bumping a runner. Near the 1100m, was allowed to stride forward and obtained the lead near the 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok went 3 Wide out of the Straight joining Leaders crossed & found the front 2 Lengths Clear (1600m), margin 5 Lengths passing 1000, Quickly came back approaching Turn , Straightened Up gone! # led/gone turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 2050m, steadied when racing in restricted room. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 9 Lengths 3 Wide , on rail at the 1400m, Drifted Back to 11 Lengths Two Wide turning, lost further ground in Straight # never featured
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Wide out didn't push on though went back last settled down 12 Lengths (1400m), closer before Turn , Straightened Up Saved Ground Inside , within 6 Lengths Straight still last though, passed one late # always well back

Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide Lead with a lap to go, went clear and led on fence rounding turn, led out and +6 Lengths at 1600m and +8 Lengths at 1300m, started to come back from the 900m, joined and immediately Headed 600m, dropped out from there. [Stewards questioned rider re tactics adopted. Jockey stated he was instructed to obtain cover So it would settle and sustain a finishing effort, but it began well and pulled its way to the lead, pulled fiercely middle stages opening up a sizeable lead. He added its racing manners early/middle stages were detrimental to its finishing efforts.] # went mad in front
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated he was instructed to obtain cover in the early stages so as to have his mount settle and sustain a finishing effort. Rdr stated his mount began well from a wide barrier and pulled its way to the lead. Rdr stated his mount continued to pull fiercely throughout the middle stages and opened up a sizeable lead, despite his effort to have it settle. Rdr stated his mounts racing manners in the early and middle stages were to the detriment of its finishing effort.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field on inside (6L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & 3 Wide @ 650m. Improving slowly from 600m & Four Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Six Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & faded in last 200m. # didn't finish off
Jumped ok rails gate urged however lacked speed Settled Down three back fence 6 Lengths (1400m), similar 600 niggled along, no run on to 200, lost Ground late (Blinkers FIRST TIME) # no run on at all
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination after racing at Taree on the 12th of May and was cleared to start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 7l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was deemed suitable to start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 5 Lengths turning, dropped right out in Straight # weakened badly
